structure: 2022 K-12 Louisiana Student Standards for Social Studies. Front matter (cover/TOC, superintendent letter, development, goals, 'Reading the Standards') then a Skills and Practices table with four columns = grade bands K-2, 3-5, 6-8, 9-12 (codes K-2.SP1-3, 3-5.SP1-3, 6-8.SP1-3, 9-12.SP1-3). The same band SP standards are repeated at the start of the K-2 (before Kindergarten), 3-5 (before Grade 3), 6-8 (before Grade 6) and 9-12 (before HS Civics) sections. Then one section per grade: 'KINDERGARTEN', 'GRADE 1'...'GRADE 8' (title + theme), each with a narrative overview paragraph (labeled examples), then standards numbered by grade (K.1, 1.1, ... 8.17). K-3 are grouped under discipline headings HISTORY / CIVICS / ECONOMICS / GEOGRAPHY (continuous numbering); grades 4-8 have no discipline headings. Bulleted standards (e.g. '5.6') have lettered sub-standards a., b. (and 'For example:' lists) run inline in the same unit; units are never split so these are labeled standards. High school courses: 'HIGH SCHOOL Civics' (C.1-C.14), 'United States History' (US.1-US.18), 'World History' (WH.1-WH.30), 'World Geography' (WG.1-WG.8), each with an overview paragraph (examples) followed by coded standards. HS courses are tied to 9-12 only. Page-marker running headers are only the Department address line, giving no grade information.
